en: The image shows a vintage collage-style postcard featuring many oval portrait photographs of individuals, likely officials or notable people, arranged in a network around a central figure. The text is in Cyrillic, and there are smaller photographic images at the bottom depicting buildings, what appears to be a railway station, a ship, and trains, indicating an association with transportation or public officials. The card is bordered and shows signs of aging.
